name: X-37B OTV-6 (USA-299, USSF-7)
first: USA-299 / USSF-7 — 908 days on orbit, KSC Shuttle Landing Facility
description: Sixth X-37B flight — first under the new USSF organisational designation; record-setting 908 days on orbit (~2.5 years). Launched 2020-05-17 13:14 UTC from CCAFS SLC-41 on Atlas V 501 AV-081; landed at KSC SLF 2022-11-12 10:22 UTC. Carried the Naval Research Laboratory PRAM (Photovoltaic RF Antenna Module — 1 W solar power-to-microwave-beaming experiment) and an AFRL FalconSAT-8 deployer.

events.label: LANDING
events.note: Autonomous runway landing at KSC Shuttle Landing Facility 2022-11-12.
